items.answer: Indicator 13 calculates the client's WL from the notch change between previous and current external rating: 2-notch downgrade → WL 1, 3+ notches → WL 2; everything else WL 0.

In scope: src/indicators/externalRating.mjs exporting externalRatingChangeWl(previous, current), plus tests. Out of scope: any change to existing code, fetching/storing ratings, combining indicators, UI/API, new dependencies.
